snapshot.what_it_does: IRCTC is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, serving as the hospitality, tourism and online ticketing arm of Indian Railways. It integrates digital ticketing, catering, tourism and packaged drinking water (Rail Neer) into a comprehensive travel ecosystem for rail passengers.

segments.name: Internet Ticketing
segments.note: Digital gateway for rail reservations; 88.74% of reserved tickets booked online (Q2 FY26); 5,304.65 lakh e-tickets booked in FY 2025-26; ₹74,834.62 crore ticket fare collected

segments.name: Catering and Hospitality
segments.note: Mobile, static and e-catering across 1,450+ trains, 420+ stations under e-Catering, 800+ AI-monitored kitchens

segments.name: Travel and Tourism
segments.note: Leisure, pilgrimage, luxury (Maharajas' Express with 43 luxury cabins) and international tourism; tourism portal gross revenue ₹699.55 crore in FY 2025-26

segments.name: Rail Neer (Packaged Drinking Water)
segments.note: 20 plants, average sales of 12.80 lakh bottles per day

snapshot.geographies: India (nationwide rail network coverage); some international tourism offerings and participation in global travel exhibitions (ITB Berlin 2026, IMEX America 2025, WTM London, Luxperience Sydney). Listed on BSE & NSE since 14.10.2019.
key_facts: Revenue from operations ₹5,214.86 crore; EBITDA ₹1,926.12 crore; PAT ₹1,393.37 crore; market capitalisation ₹39,552.00 crore as on 31st March 2026
Total income grew from ₹1,598.71 crore (FY 2016-17) to ₹5,474.97 crore (FY 2025-26); PAT from ₹214.69 crore to ₹1,393.37 crore
88.74% share of reserved ticket booking on Indian Railways online; 5,304.65 lakh e-tickets booked (+4.68% YoY); 9,308.14 lakh passengers (+4.46%)
Revenue share paid to Ministry of Railways: ₹858.01 crore in FY 2025-26 vs ₹638.50 crore in FY 2024-25
Total dividend declared ₹720 crore in FY 2025-26; EPS ₹17.42; net worth ₹4,308.38 crore

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Mixed credibility: management delivered on catering growth, Rail Neer plant sanctioning, and the RBI license submission, but overpromised on FY26 revenue growth (12% vs 15% target) and margins, which fell below 30% in Q1 FY27. Tourism and ticketing growth also ran below the ~20% and ~7% targets set on the Q4 FY26 call.

rows.promise: Submit payment aggregator license application by end-January 2026 after RBI in-principle approval.
rows.delivered: Not submitted by January; Q3 FY26 call says RBI extended deadline to August, documents still being prepared.

rows.promise: Enhance Danapur and Ambernath Rail Neer capacity from 1 lakh to 3 lakh bottles within 12 months.
rows.delivered: Still ongoing: Q4 FY26—Ambernath 2→3 lakh tendered, Danapur 1→2 lakh underway; Q1 FY27 targets FY27 completion.
rows.cite: Q4 FY26 p13; Q1 FY27 p6

rows.promise: Install four more Rail Neer plants across India, likely next fiscal.
rows.delivered: Board sanctioned four plants (Mysore, Prayagraj, Bhagalpur, Ranchi); land secured at Mysore and Prayagraj; not yet installed.
rows.cite: Q3 FY26 p6; Q4 FY26 p13

rows.promise: Achieve 15% sustainable revenue growth in FY26.
rows.delivered: FY26 revenue grew ~12% to Rs.5,215 crores, below the 15% target.

rows.promise: Submit payment aggregator license documents to RBI by extended August 2026 deadline.
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 call: application now with RBI; response expected this financial year, implying submission made.

rows.promise: No dip in tourism momentum in Q4 FY26; new Bharat Gaurav train to add revenue.
rows.delivered: Q4 tourism grew 10.95% YoY to Rs.304 crores—positive but sharply slower than Q3's 29%.

rows.promise: Maintain EBITDA margin at 30% over the medium term.
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 28.17% (actuals 28.2%), below the 30% commitment.

rows.promise: Catering revenue to keep growing around 15%.
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 catering revenue grew 33.82% YoY to INR732 crores, well above target.

rows.promise: Tourism revenue growth to continue around 20%.
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 tourism grew 13.5% YoY to INR168 crores, below the ~20% target.

rows.promise: Finalize Ambernath and Danapur Rail Neer capacity augmentation this financial year (FY27).
rows.delivered: FY27 still underway; no later call or filing in material to confirm completion.

bull.point: Online rail ticketing dominance: 88.74% reserved tickets online; 5,304.65 lakh e-tickets +4.68%, 9,308.14 lakh passengers +4.46%.
FY26 revenue ₹5,214.86 crore, EBITDA ₹1,926.12 crore, PAT ₹1,393.37 crore; dividend ₹720 crore, EPS ₹17.42.
Catering accelerated Q1 FY27 +33.82% YoY to ₹732 crore versus ~15% target.

bear.point: Guidance credibility mixed: FY26 revenue grew ~12% versus 15% target; Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 28.2% versus 30% commitment.
bear.cite: guidance-ledger: Q4 FY26 p3/p13; Q1 FY27 p4

bear.point: Margin pressure: EBITDA margin 35.3% Q2 FY26 to 27.3% Q4 FY26, 28.2% Q1 FY27.
Rising revenue share to Ministry ₹858.01 crore FY26 vs ₹638.50 crore FY25; tourism/ticketing below targets.

watch: RBI payment-aggregator response expected this financial year; approval or delay changes payments optionality.
Whether EBITDA margin recovers toward 30% after 28.2% in Q1 FY27.
Execution on Ambernath/Danapur capacity and four sanctioned Rail Neer plants; tourism growth versus ~20% target.
